definition.@DataWarehouse.sqlEditor.query:
SELECT 
    b."BATCH_ID",
    CURRENT_UTCTIMESTAMP () AS "LOAD_TIMESTAMP",
    'HIST_RAW' AS "SOURCE_SYSTEM",
    o."SOURCE_FILE",
    "d"."KOKRS","d"."KOSTL","d"."DATBI","d"."DATAB","d"."BKZKP","d"."PKZKP","d"."BUKRS","d"."GSBER","d"."KOSAR","d"."VERAK","d"."VERAK_USER","d"."WAERS","d"."KALSM","d"."TXJCD","d"."PRCTR","d"."WERKS","d"."LOGSYSTEM","d"."ERSDA","d"."USNAM","d"."BKZKS","d"."BKZER","d"."BKZOB","d"."PKZKS","d"."PKZER","d"."VMETH","d"."MGEFL","d"."ABTEI","d"."NKOST","d"."KVEWE","d"."KAPPL","d"."KOSZSCHL","d"."LAND1","d"."ANRED","d"."NAME1","d"."NAME2","d"."NAME3","d"."NAME4","d"."ORT01","d"."ORT02","d"."STRAS","d"."PFACH","d"."PSTLZ","d"."PSTL2","d"."REGIO","d"."SPRAS","d"."TELBX","d"."TELF1","d"."TELF2","d"."TELFX","d"."TELTX","d"."TELX1","d"."DATLT","d"."DRNAM","d"."KHINR","d"."CCKEY","d"."KOMPL","d"."STAKZ","d"."OBJNR","d"."FUNKT","d"."AFUNK","d"."CPI_TEMPL","d"."CPD_TEMPL","d"."FUNC_AREA","d"."SCI_TEMPL","d"."SCD_TEMPL","d"."ZZAD_SMTPADR","d"."ZPOAPPR_USR_1","d"."ZPOAPPR_US_NM_1","d"."ZPOAPPR_USR_3","d"."ZPOAPPR_US_NM_3","d"."ZPOAPPR_USR_4","d"."ZPOAPPR_US_NM_4","d"."VNAME","d"."RECID","d"."ETYPE","d"."JV_OTYPE","d"."JV_JIBCL","d"."JV_JIBSA","d"."FERC_IND","d"."KTEXT","d"."LTEXT","d"."MCTXT"
FROM "1_INBOUND_HIST_RAW.1LT_CSKS_HIST_RAW" d
	CROSS JOIN "2SV_ACTIVE_BATCH_HIST_RAW_01" b
	JOIN "2LT_CTRL_LOAD_OBJECT_01" o 
	    ON o."BATCH_ID" = b."BATCH_ID" 
	        AND o."SOURCE_SYSTEM" = 'HIST_RAW' 
	        AND o."OBJECT_NAME" = 'CSKS'
